topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Oh no, seriously? Your car was towed from your own driveway? That’s like, the most not okay thing ever. I mean, how does that even happen? And what were they thinking, like, you’re at home, it’s safe, it’s your place. This is so messed up. I can’t even fathom what you must be going through right now, trying to figure everything out and probably just wanting to crawl back into bed. But hey, we can sort this out. We’re gonna get to the bottom of this and make sure they know just how wrong this is. Just text me the details, and I’ll be there in a second to help you sort through all this craziness, okay? You’re not alone in this.
